cdmTableName = PERSON
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        num_violated_rows 
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            CASE 
                WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END AS num_violated_rows
        FROM main.PERSON cdmTable
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 1 AS num_rows
) denominator
;

/*********
Table Level:  
MEASURE_PERSON_COMPLETENESS
Determine what #/% of persons have at least one record in the cdmTable
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = PERSON
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.person_id) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT 
			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.person cdmTable
			LEFT JOIN main.PERSON cdmTable2 
			    ON cdmTable.person_id = cdmTable2.person_id
		WHERE cdmTable2.person_id IS NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.person cdmTable
) denominator
;

MEASURE_PERSON_COMPLETENESS
Determine what #/% of persons have at least one record in the cdmTable
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = PERSON
**********/

	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.person_id) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/

			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.person cdmTable
			LEFT JOIN main.PERSON cdmTable2 
			    ON cdmTable.person_id = cdmTable2.person_id
		WHERE cdmTable2.person_id IS NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.person cdmTable
) denominator
;
